name: ftc-monorepo
description: Fork, Paper Trail, Coach: a Claude Code plugin with a local service and web app.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm plugin:bundle && corepack pnpm plugin:web
scripts.check: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm test
scripts.plugin:validate: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate ./packages/plugin
scripts.mock:refresh: corepack pnpm --filter @ftc/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @ftc/server sample-data
scripts.eval: corepack pnpm --filter @ftc/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @ftc/server eval
scripts.eval:save-run: corepack pnpm --filter @ftc/server build && corepack pnpm --filter @ftc/server eval:save-run
